text:
jess-runtime: Morning — quick async checkpoint on crossbeam sprint (kernel + continuous batching + KV prefetch). I pulled a short milestone table. Who's ok to confirm owners & blockers?

omar-kernel: Owner for kernel prefetch: omar-kernel. Goal: land PR for handshake + tiny refactor by Thu EOD. Blocker: race on kv_cache->evict when concurrent prefetch hits. Reproducer in test_kv_eviction.py attached.

li-ml: KV prefetch perf numbers from last run: headroom ~18% lower p99 token latency with prefetch=4 on g5.2x. But memory bump + cache thrash at sequence>1024. Sharing flame link: https://ci.company/flake/3278

taylor-platform: Platform notes: Dedicated pool needs a config flag for continuous batching policy. I'll own config rollout. Need a backwards-compatible key: "runtime.continuous_batching.enabled" — will add feature flag in infra repo. Will coordinate canary.

sam-sre: FYI infra quota: two dedicated nodes in us-west are at 92% GPU mem due to large-model tests. Can we shift heavy perf runs to staging? Raising alert if we cross 95%.

jess-runtime: @omar-kernel can you paste the failing log snippet? @li-ml thanks — can you add the exact command you used for the perf run?

omar-kernel: Sure, log:
```
E2026-03-15 09:12:43 kernel.cc:482] kv_cache: evict triggered for shard 7 while handshake pending
stack: ...
```
Repro steps:
1) start runtime with KV_PREFETCH=1
2) run perf/sim/repro_eviction.py --concurrency 128
Patch in review: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2157

li-ml: Command:
```
bazel run //perf:bench -- --model=gpt-small --seq=2048 --concurrency=64 --prefetch=4
```
Result: p50 60ms -> 49ms p50; p99 320ms -> 262ms. Added cache hit rate +14%. Notes in PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving-evals/pull/92

taylor-platform: I'll add the feature flag and stage rollout tomorrow morning. Can someone add a config default to avoid performance regression on seq>1024?

jess-runtime: Owner table — paste:
Owners:
- Kernel prefetch refactor: omar-kernel
- Continuous batching policy (config + rollout): taylor-platform
- KV cache tuning + perf tests: li-ml
- SRE infra coordination: sam-sre
Milestones:
- Kernel PR merged by Thu EOD (1852080000)
- Flag rollout canary Mon (1852166400)
- Perf validation + regression tests Tue (1852252800)

omar-kernel: small ask — need @taylor-platform to unblock kernel test infra: kernel unit tests rely on a feature flag in conf; can you expose a test-only env var RUNTIME_ENABLE_PREFETCH_TESTS=true?

taylor-platform: Yes, will do. Will add to test harness and update docs.

ci-bot: Build passed for PR 2157 — https://ci.company/build/2157 :white_check_mark:

li-ml: Quick code review ping @omar-kernel — left comments on edge case around seq 0 handling. Could you address before merge?

omar-kernel: Will respond tonight. If I can't fix before Thu, plan B: revert prefetch for sequences >1024 using runtime flag.

sam-sre: Also adding a temporary autoscale bump for canary window so perf jobs don't get queued. Patch: infra/auto/scale.yml updated.

jess-runtime: Thanks all. Action items: omar fix eviction race or gate >1024; taylor add flag and test env var; li finalize perf PR; sam bump canary capacity. I'll follow up in tomorrow sync. :thumbsup:
